methods.what: Potential of a plane disc mass distribution as double integral
Kernel g_n as Beta-type integral expanded in hypergeometric power series with Π (Gamma) coefficients
Logarithmic case expansion of g'_n with finite sum plus series containing log and digamma ψ terms
Potential of density f(x)cos n(θ−β) reduces to Fα cos n(ψ−β) with Fα given by integral of the kernel
Explicit densities giving power potentials α^{n+2m} and α^{n-2m-1}
Abel-type relation between density and potential via auxiliary function p(x)
Inversion formula expressing Λ F via iterated integral
